newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude recedes in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude recedes in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil receded in late U.S. paper dealings on Wednesday, traders said.
Three June Brent partials were heard traded, twice at $18.50 and once at $18.39 a barrel.
June Brent settled at $18.52 on London's IPE.
A full boat of July Brent switched hands at $18.61 a barrel, down a penny from the London close.
July Brent partials traded between $18.53 and $18.57.
June/July Brent traded three times, once at minus 12 cents and twice at minus 13 cents. Minus eight cents changed hands earlier in the day.
